cells.action: Implement CONTEXT.md D1. (1) New packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/test_support.rs, declared in main.rs as #[cfg(test)] mod test_support;, with pub(crate) fn built_bee() -> PathBuf that walks std::env::current_exe() ancestors and returns the first ancestor.join(format!("bee{}", std::env::consts::EXE_SUFFIX)) that is_file(); panic naming the start path when none. Put the walk in a pure fn taking the start path so a test can drive it. (2) In each of the 9 integration test files under crates/bee/tests that compute the binary from current_exe, replace that lookup with PathBuf::from(env!("CARGO_BIN_EXE_bee")) (keep the local fn name if callers use it, or inline). (3) In crates/bee/src unit tests: replace assert_cmd Command::cargo_bin("bee") in verbs/plan_group.rs and verbs/upkeep_group.rs with assert_cmd::Command::new(crate::test_support::built_bee()); replace the hand-rolled lookups in verbs/report.rs (near 1073), verbs/design_group.rs (near 804), verbs/status_full/tests.rs (near 483) and onboard/tests.rs (near 723) with crate::test_support::built_bee(). rg the crate for any other current_exe- or cargo_bin-based bee lookup in test code and migrate it too. (4) docs/knowledge/areas/verify-pipeline/suite-topology-and-discovery.md: one sentence that tests find the binary through CARGO_BIN_EXE_bee (integration) or test_support::built_bee (unit), because Cargo 1.100 moved test executables to build/<pkg>/<hash>/out; cite cargo-build-dir-tests D1 (never raw ids). Use CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/home/thanhsmind/.cache/cargo-target-r100 for the +1.100.0 run and /home/thanhsmind/.cache/cargo-target-mmd for the default run. Discard the tracked packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/.bee/logs/timings.jsonl change before committing. No code comments; delete the old lookup comments only where they described the removed code. Commit once (cell trailer). Proof: the verify command; quote both suites' pass and fail counts.
